title: Portable verification export
responsibility: Builds a standalone HTML report for one recorded verification with available media embedded.

inputs.name: consoleExport.input
inputs.description: Commit, optional record identifier, index/detail JSON and asynchronous media loader. Requested records fall back to a valid passed record, then the first record.

inputs.name: consoleExport.assets
inputs.description: Compiled viewer assets used by the portable page renderer.

outputs.name: consoleExport
outputs.description: Resolves to portable HTML, or undefined when the requested commit summary or any usable record choice is absent. Media bytes become data URLs; missing media is marked missing.
